cost_budget_approval: accepted for descriptive DEV comparison by user continuation; not a release or independent quality threshold
metric_engine: scripts/b1-summarize-matrix.py::citation_metrics; exact source commit and location-overlap matching; not factual answer support
uncertainty: collapse repetitions per question then average questions per fact cluster; 4 proposed CODE clusters, independent approval 0; no significance or quality improvement verdict
failure_policy: missing/error/timeout retrieval slots remain planned denominator with all retrieval metrics zero; warm errors excluded from latency quantiles but separate error fraction over all planned calls; never describe latency as passing if errors/missing occurred
guard_policy: OP-07/08 checked separately; not added to retrieval denominator or answer-abstention rate; exactly one read-only trace per guard; expected tuple/missing_code/acceptance_evaluated=false
paired_inputs: same binary SHA/dataset/snapshot/source/model/requests/config except ontology_mode and footprint path; off baseline keeps raw-query-first shared with concept_text; validate before/after bindings
backend_policy: sum request-scoped /api/embed and /api/tags attempts separately; startup scopes separate; constructor probes outside scope explicitly uncounted
body_policy: report citation order/membership/body deltas; validate v2 source/body/integrity before retrieval metrics; body changes are not an improvement verdict
